name: Kingda Ka
note: Centreline and structure measured from the USGS 3DEP lidar flown on 2019-03-08 while the ride stood (NJ_SouthJersey_2018 dataset; the 2010 3-county survey for the tower's vertical runs), guided by OpenStreetMap as of 2024-06-01; what the station roof hides follows the published layout. tools/ka/README.md.
units: metres; x east, y up, z south of extent.py LAT0/LON0; y above the datum (the median ground under the ride)
assumed: the station lanes between a = -166.5 and -144.0 along the launch line (under the roof), and the S-curves that join them to the launch line
which of the two lanes the train uses (the one on the launch side, away from the brake run); sidings[0] is the other
the height of the track under the roof (carried level between the returns either side)
the roll going up is placed where the 2010 returns show the truss sliding across (76-104 m; 51 returns, weak); its sense (to the right) is the published one
the roll coming down turns about a line 1.40 m above the rails: the radius that fits the returns best, within about half a metre
where the brakes section starts (the descent eased to 14 degrees); brakes.fins_s0, the hill crest, is where photographs show the first fins
